answer_1.quote: In our reproduction experiments (Section 4), following ..., ... and ..., we use ... for MT evaluation. Besides, we follow ... to use TAC2008 and TAC2009 for text summarization evaluation, MSCOCO ... for image captioning (IC) evaluation, and BAGEL ... and SFHOTEL ... for data-to-text generation (D2T) evaluation.

answer_2.quote: We investigate whether these more recent metrics have better reproducibility properties... We consider MoverScore, BERTScore, BaryScore, and SentSim.

answer_4.quote: Two types of human judgments serve as the golden standard. The first one is Direct Assessment (DA), which contains human scores for each translation. The second one is DArr, which consists of conclusions about one translation being better than another drawn from DA scores.
answer_4.guideline: Each system summary receives 4 human judgements according to two criteria: 1) Pyramid, which reflects the level of content coverage of the summaries; and 2) Responsiveness, which measures the response level to the overall quality of linguistic and content of the summaries.
